description: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA) from public resolvers (Cloudflare, with Google and Quad9 as fallbacks), the domain's IP addresses, the network owner of its first IP (ASN, network name, prefix, country), its HTTP response headers, and a ping summary.
